headline: Revenue growth accelerates as margins swing to profitability
summary_short: HubSpot's Q2 2026 revenue rose to $911.7M (+19.8% y/y, +3.5% q/q) on 20% as-reported subscription growth, while GAAP net income swung to $43.3M from a $3.3M loss a year ago as operating margin expanded to 4.8% from -3.2%.
summary_long: Revenue was $911.7M, up 19.8% y/y (20% as-reported, 17% constant-currency), driven by 20% subscription growth as customers grew 14% to 306,446. GAAP operating income turned to $43.3M from a $24.6M loss, with GAAP operating margin reaching 4.8% from -3.2% as revenue growth outpaced total opex growth of 6.7% y/y. Net income was $43.3M ($0.86 diluted EPS) versus a $3.3M loss a year ago, aided by 3.9% fewer diluted shares from $531.9M of quarterly buybacks. Cash and equivalents were $958.3M (+59.4% y/y). HubSpot guided Q3 2026 revenue to $924.0-$925.0M and FY2026 revenue to $3.678-$3.686B.

drivers.explanation: Growth was driven by 20% growth in subscription revenue (98% of total revenue) plus 8% growth in professional services and other revenue, with customers up 14% to 306,446.
Increase tracks a rise in stock-based compensation allocated to subscription cost of revenue (from $8.2M to $11.8M) alongside the underlying revenue growth.
Turned positive as total operating expenses grew only 6.7% y/y ($663.3M to $707.5M) while revenue grew 19.8% y/y, driving GAAP operating margin from -3.2% to 4.8%.
Swing to profitability mirrors the operating-income improvement, despite lower interest income ($9.4M vs $18.3M a year ago) as cash was redeployed to buybacks.
Combination of higher net income and 3.9% fewer weighted diluted shares (50.6M vs 52.7M y/y) following $531.9M of share repurchases this quarter.
Fell 19.8% y/y and 17.0% q/q as $742.9M of year-to-date share repurchases reduced paid-in capital, partly offset by $75.9M of six-month net income.
"we made deliberate choices to accelerate our AI transformation," said CEO Yamini Rangan, citing pricing and go-to-market changes tied to the company's agentic-AI product push.
